description: This Java class manages mDNS/Bonjour service advertisement and discovery using JmDNS in a background HandlerThread, handling visibility, network status, and service registration for nearby peers in an Android app.

classes.name: BonjourManager
classes.description: Manages mDNS/Bonjour service registration and discovery in a background thread, handling visibility, network status, and peer broadcasting.

methods.name: isAlive
methods.description: Checks if the handler thread managing Bonjour services is active.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops Bonjour/mDNS services and broadcasts the stopped status.

methods.name: setVisible
methods.description: Sets the visibility of the Bonjour service, handling VPN conflicts.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts Bonjour/mDNS services with default preferences.

methods.name: start (overloaded)
methods.description: Initializes and starts the Bonjour service with specified parameters and service listeners.

methods.name: restart
methods.description: Restarts the Bonjour service with current preferences.

methods.name: restart (overloaded)
methods.description: Restarts the Bonjour service with specified parameters.

methods.name: sendBroadcast (String, ServiceInfo)
methods.description: Broadcasts a peer found or removed event.

methods.name: isVpnActive
methods.description: Checks if a VPN connection is active.
